mechanism_narrative: A low current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns is above -0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital for corporations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns is above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPIAUCSL (above 250) and low UNRATE (below 4.0%) together signal an overheating economy with rising inflation and a tight labor market, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive policy response to inflation, increasing the discount rate for equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment growth (PAYEMS), signals robust corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE predicting 20-day returns is above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST above 1600) and robust industrial production (INDPRO above 104) together signal a broad-based economic expansion that may lead to overheating and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflation fears and policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 and INDPRO > 104, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high level of real GDP (GDPC1 above 19200 billion) signals that the economy is near its potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the central bank prepares to tighten policy.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 19200, or Rank IC for GDPC1 in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
